title: LLM4Decompile: Decompiling Binary Code with Large Language Models
date_basis: ACL proceedings publication month
description_en: Trains language models for assembly-to-C decompilation and for refining Ghidra pseudocode, evaluating whether recovered functions can be recompiled and executed correctly.
description_zh: 训练语言模型将汇编反编译为 C，并改进 Ghidra 伪代码，以恢复函数能否重新编译并正确执行为评估目标。
scope_limitations_en: The paper limits its experiments to C on x86 and function-level benchmarks. Re-executability on sampled tests does not establish whole-program equivalence or recovery of the original source. Later repository releases are separate from the 2024 paper.
scope_limitations_zh: 论文实验限定于 x86 平台的 C 代码和函数级基准。通过抽样测试重新执行，不代表整程序等价或恢复了原始源码。仓库后续版本应与 2024 年论文区分。
why_fits_en: Direct evidence for LLM decompilation and a concrete baseline for evaluating agent-generated or refined pseudocode.
why_fits_zh: 直接研究 LLM 反编译，可作为评估智能体生成或改进伪代码的具体基线。
metadata_notes: Publication date is the conference month; first_arxiv_date is recorded separately.
title_zh: LLM4Decompile：使用大语言模型反编译二进制代码
date_basis_zh: ACL 会议论文集的出版月份。
metadata_notes_zh: 出版日期采用会议论文集月份；arXiv 首次提交日期单独记录。

title: DecompileBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Decompilers in Real-World Scenarios
date_basis: ACL proceedings publication month
description_en: Evaluates traditional and LLM-based decompilers using functions from real programs, runtime behavioral checks, and an LLM-assisted assessment of analyst-facing code understandability.
description_zh: 利用真实程序中的函数、运行时行为检查，以及 LLM 辅助的代码可理解性评估，比较传统反编译器与基于 LLM 的方法。
scope_limitations_en: The evaluated corpus has 23,400 functions from 130 programs. Fuzzing-based checks have finite coverage, and understandability scores depend partly on an LLM judge. The artifact warns that rebuilt OSS-Fuzz projects can differ from the paper's versions.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估语料包含 130 个程序中的 23,400 个函数。基于模糊测试的检查覆盖有限，可理解性评分部分依赖 LLM 评审器。研究产物说明，重新构建的 OSS-Fuzz 项目可能与论文版本不同。
why_fits_en: Helps readers separate readable decompiler output from behaviorally faithful output when choosing or evaluating reverse-engineering tools.
why_fits_zh: 帮助读者在选择或评估逆向工具时，区分输出的可读性与行为保真度。
metadata_notes: The published ACL record and PDF use 'Zhang Bolun'; the arXiv record uses 'Bolun Zhang'. The paper's Jennieett/DecompileBench link now redirects to vul337/DecompileBench. This is distinct from Tan et al.'s Decompile-Bench (arXiv:2505.12668).
title_zh: DecompileBench：面向真实场景的反编译器综合评测基准
date_basis_zh: ACL 会议论文集的出版月份。
metadata_notes_zh: 正式 ACL 记录与 PDF 使用作者名 Zhang Bolun，arXiv 记录使用 Bolun Zhang。论文中的 Jennieett/DecompileBench 链接现重定向至 vul337/DecompileBench。该论文不同于 Tan 等人的 Decompile-Bench（arXiv:2505.12668）。

title: DIRE: A Neural Approach to Decompiled Identifier Naming
date_basis: Publisher-deposited Crossref print-publication month; the 11–15 November 2019 conference dates are not used to assert a publication day.
description_en: Combines lexical and structural information from decompiler output to predict meaningful variable names, with a training and evaluation corpus derived from compiled C projects.
description_zh: 结合反编译输出中的词法与结构信息预测有意义的变量名，并使用编译 C 项目构建训练和评估语料。
scope_limitations_en: This is learned identifier naming, not complete source reconstruction or an autonomous agent. Its reported results concern an x86-64 C corpus and depend on decompiler output. The original author repository is deprecated and points to a successor.
scope_limitations_zh: 该工作研究学习式标识符命名，并非完整源码重建或自主智能体。报告结果针对 x86-64 C 代码语料，并依赖反编译器输出。原作者仓库已标记弃用，并指向后续项目。
why_fits_en: A foundational reference for the renaming step frequently delegated to reverse-engineering assistants.
why_fits_zh: 为逆向助手常执行的变量重命名步骤提供基础研究依据。
metadata_notes: IEEE/ACM ASE 2019 proceedings, pages 628–639; the DOI resolves to IEEE Xplore document 8952404. The publisher-deposited and arXiv titles use 'Naming'; the ASE program and original code repository use the variant 'Renaming'. Both refer to this paper. Crossref lists 'Edward Schwartz'; the paper's own 'Edward J. Schwartz' is retained. Code URL is the verified original author artifact, explicitly deprecated, rather than a claim of current package support.
title_zh: DIRE：基于神经网络的反编译标识符命名方法
date_basis_zh: 采用出版方在 Crossref 登记的印刷出版月份；不以 2019 年 11 月 11—15 日的会议日期推定具体出版日。
metadata_notes_zh: 发表于 IEEE/ACM ASE 2019 会议论文集，页码为 628–639；该 DOI 解析至 IEEE Xplore 文档 8952404。出版方登记的标题与 arXiv 标题均使用 Naming，ASE 会议日程与原始代码仓库使用 Renaming 这一变体，均指向同一论文。Crossref 将一位作者记为 Edward Schwartz，本条目保留论文署名 Edward J. Schwartz。代码链接为已确认的原作者研究产物，已明确弃用，并不表示当前软件包仍受支持。

title: Augmenting Decompiler Output with Learned Variable Names and Types
date_basis: USENIX proceedings BibTeX publication month
description_en: Introduces DIRTY, a Transformer model that recommends variable names and types from decompiled code and layout information, together with the DIRT corpus for training and evaluation.
description_zh: 提出 Transformer 模型 DIRTY，根据反编译代码和布局信息推荐变量名与类型，并提供用于训练和评估的 DIRT 语料。
scope_limitations_en: The original pipeline is built around C programs and Hex-Rays output. Predicted names and types are learned hypotheses, not guaranteed original symbols. The published paper is from 2022, although its arXiv preprint first appeared in 2021.
scope_limitations_zh: 原始流程围绕 C 程序和 Hex-Rays 输出构建。预测名称与类型是模型推断，不保证与原始符号一致。正式论文发表于 2022 年，arXiv 预印本首次提交于 2021 年。
why_fits_en: Extends name recovery to types, making it directly relevant to assessing semantic annotations added by binary-analysis assistants.
why_fits_zh: 将名称恢复扩展到类型恢复，直接帮助评估二进制分析助手添加的语义注释。
metadata_notes: Year and publication month come from the final USENIX conference record; the arXiv date is not substituted for publication.
title_zh: 利用学习得到的变量名称与类型增强反编译输出
date_basis_zh: USENIX 论文集 BibTeX 记录中的出版月份。
metadata_notes_zh: 年份与出版月份来自正式 USENIX 会议记录，不以较早的 arXiv 提交日期代替。

title: ReSym: Harnessing LLMs to Recover Variable and Data Structure Symbols from Stripped Binaries
date_basis: ACM-deposited Crossref print-publication date; the October 14–18 CCS 2024 conference week is not used as the publication date.
description_en: Combines two fine-tuned language models with Prolog-based cross-function reasoning to infer local-variable symbols and user-defined data structures from stripped-binary decompilation.
description_zh: 结合两个微调语言模型与基于 Prolog 的跨函数推理，从去符号二进制的反编译结果中推断局部变量符号及用户自定义数据结构。
scope_limitations_en: The method depends on underlying decompilation and learned predictions over C/C++ data. Cross-checking reduces conflicting predictions but does not prove that recovered names or layouts match the unavailable source. The public artifact includes models, processed data, and evaluation code.
scope_limitations_zh: 该方法依赖底层反编译结果及针对 C/C++ 数据学习的预测。交叉检查可减少预测冲突，但不能证明恢复的名称或布局与缺失源码完全一致。公开研究产物包含模型、处理后的数据与评估代码。
why_fits_en: A concrete hybrid approach for grounding LLM-generated reverse-engineering annotations in program analysis.
why_fits_zh: 展示如何结合程序分析，为 LLM 生成的逆向工程注释提供依据。
metadata_notes: ACM metadata records print publication on 2024-12-02 and online publication on 2024-12-09, pages 4554–4568. The author-hosted published PDF identifies the event as CCS ’24, held October 14–18, 2024 in Salt Lake City. The DOI, title, six authors and venue agree with the publisher record and the official author artifact.
title_zh: ReSym：利用大语言模型恢复去符号二进制中的变量与数据结构符号
date_basis_zh: 采用 ACM 在 Crossref 登记的印刷出版日期；不将 CCS 2024 于 10 月 14—18 日举行的会议周作为出版日期。
metadata_notes_zh: ACM 元数据记载印刷出版于 2024-12-02，在线出版于 2024-12-09，页码为 4554–4568。作者托管的正式 PDF 标注 CCS ’24 于 2024 年 10 月 14—18 日在盐湖城举行，该日期仅为会议举办时间。DOI、标题、六位作者及会议均与出版方记录和官方作者研究产物一致。

title: CrackMeBench: Binary Reverse Engineering for Agents
date_basis: arXiv v1 submission
description_en: Evaluates agents on executable-checked CrackMe tasks: infer validation logic from binaries and submit an accepted input or artifact, while recording tool use, time, and scoring attempts.
description_zh: 用可执行程序判定结果的 CrackMe 任务评估智能体：从二进制推断验证逻辑，提交可被接受的输入或产物，并记录工具使用、耗时与评分尝试。
scope_limitations_en: The v0 study uses 12 generated tasks and eight public calibration tasks, Linux x86-64 ELF binaries, a shell interface, and a five-minute budget. Its compact educational tasks do not establish performance on large applications. No paper-linked public artifact URL was verified.
scope_limitations_zh: v0 研究使用 12 个生成任务和 8 个公开校准任务，限定 Linux x86-64 ELF、Shell 接口和五分钟预算。紧凑的教学任务不能证明大型应用上的表现。未确认论文直接关联的公开研究产物 URL。
why_fits_en: Directly measures whether an autonomous reverse-engineering workflow produces a verifiably accepted result.
why_fits_zh: 直接衡量自主逆向工程流程能否产生可验证、被目标程序接受的结果。
metadata_notes: No conference venue is stated in the reviewed arXiv record. Tool repositories cited in its bibliography are not treated as the paper's own code.
title_zh: CrackMeBench：面向智能体的二进制逆向工程基准
date_basis_zh: arXiv v1 首次提交日期。
metadata_notes_zh: 所审阅 arXiv 记录未标明会议发表场所。参考文献中的工具仓库不视为论文自己的代码产物。

title: CREBench: Evaluating Large Language Models in Cryptographic Binary Reverse Engineering
date_basis: Publication year from the official COLM 2026 OpenReview record and its BibTeX; no finer publication date is asserted.
description_en: Benchmarks cryptographic binary reverse engineering across algorithm recognition, key or IV extraction, wrapper reconstruction, and flag recovery using 432 controlled challenges.
description_zh: 通过 432 个受控挑战，评估密码二进制逆向中的算法识别、密钥或 IV 提取、包装层重建及标志恢复。
scope_limitations_en: The corpus combines 48 algorithms, three insecure key-use scenarios, and three difficulty levels. It excludes professional-grade obfuscators such as Tigress and O-LLVM; results should not be generalized to heavily protected arbitrary binaries.
scope_limitations_zh: 语料组合 48 种算法、三类不安全密钥使用场景和三个难度等级。它不覆盖 Tigress、O-LLVM 等专业混淆器，结果不应推广到任意重度保护的二进制文件。
why_fits_en: Provides a focused, decomposed test of cryptographic behavior recovery, with a verified official implementation.
why_fits_zh: 对密码行为恢复提供细分、聚焦的测试，并有已确认的官方实现。
metadata_notes: The COLM 2026 OpenReview record has the same title, seven authors and abstract as arXiv v2 (2026-08-06), whose header reads 'Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026' and which the official project calls its camera-ready version. OpenReview’s 2026-07-08 publication timestamp coincides with the project’s acceptance announcement and is not used as a publication date; the October 6–9, 2026 conference and its Poster Session 5 listing are event details. The repository BibTeX still cites arXiv. This is unrelated to the creativity-evaluation paper also named CreBench.
title_zh: CREBench：评估大语言模型的密码二进制逆向工程能力
date_basis_zh: 采用 COLM 2026 官方 OpenReview 记录及其 BibTeX 标明的出版年份，不推定更精确的出版日期。
metadata_notes_zh: COLM 2026 的 OpenReview 记录与 arXiv v2（2026-08-06）的标题、七位作者及摘要一致；v2 页首标注“Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026”，官方项目也说明其为会议终稿版本。OpenReview 记录的发布时间 2026-07-08 与项目公布接收的日期相同，不作为出版日期；2026 年 10 月 6—9 日的会议及第 5 场海报环节安排属于会议信息。仓库 BibTeX 仍采用 arXiv 引用。该工作与另一篇同名 CreBench 的创造力评估论文无关。

title: The Next Challenge for Agentic Cybersecurity: A Realistic, Contamination-Free Reverse Engineering Benchmark
date_basis: arXiv v1 submission; summary and author list use revised v2
description_en: Introduces SRE-Bench, with privately authored programs and protected binary variants, to study agent recovery of program semantics while reducing training-data contamination.
description_zh: 提出 SRE-Bench，使用私有编写的程序及带保护机制的二进制变体，研究智能体恢复程序语义的能力，并减少训练数据污染。
scope_limitations_en: The revised study reports 19 programs, 262 binary instances, and 1,572 graded tasks. Binaries and task instances are not publicly released; access is through an evaluation service. Its contamination-control claim is the authors' methodology, not an independent guarantee.
scope_limitations_zh: 修订版研究报告 19 个程序、262 个二进制实例和 1,572 个评分任务。二进制与任务实例未公开发布，只能通过评估服务访问。污染控制是作者的方法论主张，并非独立保证。
why_fits_en: Adds realistic-scale and contamination-aware evaluation context for agent-assisted reverse engineering without mislabeling a private corpus as open data.
why_fits_zh: 为智能体辅助逆向补充真实规模和数据污染控制的评估背景，同时明确私有语料的访问限制。
metadata_notes: Use the 12-author v2 list, revised 2026-10-01, rather than the older eight-author v1 search snippets. No conference venue or own public code repository was verified. AgentRE-Bench GitHub links in the bibliography refer to another benchmark.
title_zh: 智能体网络安全的下一项挑战：真实场景且无训练数据污染的逆向工程基准
date_basis_zh: arXiv v1 首次提交日期；摘要与作者名单依据修订版 v2。
metadata_notes_zh: 使用 2026-10-01 修订的 v2 十二位作者名单，而非旧 v1 搜索摘要中的八位作者。未确认会议发表场所或论文自己的公开代码仓库。参考文献中的 AgentRE-Bench GitHub 链接属于另一项基准。

title: Humans vs. Machines: A Comparison With AI Agents in Software Reverse Engineering
date_basis: arXiv v1 submission
description_en: Compares human and LLM-agent understanding and navigation on the same static reverse-engineering challenges, then studies how binary representations consume context windows.
description_zh: 比较人类与 LLM 智能体在相同静态逆向挑战中的理解和导航方式，并研究二进制表示如何占用上下文窗口。
scope_limitations_en: Understanding is graded on two compact challenges; the separate 4,000-binary study measures context capacity, not task-solving accuracy. The interface is static IDA/MCP without dynamic execution, and prior exposure to challenge source remains an acknowledged validity threat.
scope_limitations_zh: 理解能力仅在两个紧凑挑战上评分；另一个包含 4,000 个二进制文件的实验测量上下文容量，并非解题准确率。接口为不含动态执行的静态 IDA/MCP，模型曾接触挑战源码的可能性仍是作者承认的有效性威胁。
why_fits_en: Informs tool-interface design, selective retrieval, and persistent analysis state for reverse-engineering agents.
why_fits_zh: 为逆向智能体的工具接口、选择性检索及持久分析状态设计提供依据。
metadata_notes: Recent preprint, with no confirmed conference venue or paper-specific public code link. arXiv marks its generated DOI as pending registration, so the canonical link is the arXiv record.
title_zh: 人类与机器：AI 智能体在软件逆向工程中的对比研究
date_basis_zh: arXiv v1 首次提交日期。
metadata_notes_zh: 这是一篇近期预印本，尚未确认会议发表场所或论文专属公开代码链接。arXiv 将其生成的 DOI 标为待注册，因此采用 arXiv 记录作为规范链接。

title: Design2Code: Benchmarking Multimodal Code Generation for Automated Front-End Engineering
date_basis: ACL proceedings publication month
description_en: Evaluates reconstruction of frontend code from webpage screenshots using real-world reference pages, visual-element and layout metrics, and human assessment.
description_zh: 使用真实网页参考、视觉元素和布局指标及人工评估，测试从网页截图重建前端代码的能力。
scope_limitations_en: This is visual website reconstruction, not binary decompilation or recovery of backend behavior and interactive workflows. The main benchmark contains 484 webpages with placeholder images; code and data have separate licensing terms.
scope_limitations_zh: 该工作属于网站视觉重建，不涉及二进制反编译，也不恢复后端行为或交互工作流。主基准含 484 个使用占位图的网页，代码与数据分别采用各自的许可条款。
why_fits_en: Directly supports the collection's screenshot-to-website reconstruction scope while keeping visual fidelity separate from behavioral equivalence.
why_fits_zh: 直接支持集合中的截图到网站重建主题，并明确区分视觉相似度与行为等价性。
metadata_notes: Use the final NAACL 2025 title and six-author list; the older project page/arXiv-era citation has a different title and omits Ryan Li. SALT-NLP/Design2Code hosts the project website, whereas NoviScl/Design2Code is the verified research-code repository.
title_zh: Design2Code：面向自动化前端工程的多模态代码生成评测
date_basis_zh: ACL 会议论文集的出版月份。
metadata_notes_zh: 采用正式 NAACL 2025 标题及六位作者名单；较早的项目页和 arXiv 阶段引用使用不同标题，且未列 Ryan Li。SALT-NLP/Design2Code 托管项目网站，NoviScl/Design2Code 才是已确认的研究代码仓库。

title: Interaction2Code: Benchmarking MLLM-based Interactive Webpage Code Generation from Interactive Prototyping
title_zh: Interaction2Code：从交互原型生成网页代码的多模态大语言模型评测基准
date_basis: Publisher-deposited Crossref print-publication date; this also matches the conference start date.
date_basis_zh: 采用出版商在 Crossref 登记的印刷出版日期，该日期也与会议开幕日期一致。
description_en: Benchmarks reconstruction of interactive webpages from screenshots before and after an interaction. The final study covers 127 webpages and 374 interactions, comparing rendered appearance, automated interaction checks, and human usability judgments.
description_zh: 评测模型根据交互前后的截图重建可交互网页的能力。最终研究涵盖 127 个网页、374 项交互，并比较渲染外观、自动交互检查与人工可用性判断。
scope_limitations_en: The inputs specify individual interaction transitions, not autonomous exploration of a complete site. Its tests do not establish long-workflow, server-side, or original-source equivalence; a detectable interaction is not necessarily usable.
scope_limitations_zh: 输入描述单项交互的状态变化，并非自主探索完整网站。测试不能证明长流程、服务端行为或原始源码等价；交互能够被检测到，也不代表它可用。
why_fits_en: Extends screenshot reconstruction with concrete behavioral checks, helping distinguish visual similarity from usable interaction.
why_fits_zh: 在截图重建中加入具体的行为检查，有助于区分视觉相似与交互可用。
metadata_notes: Uses the final nine-author title and author list. The 2026 arXiv v3 revision is separate from the 2025 conference publication; the earlier preprint used a different title, five authors, and a smaller benchmark.
metadata_notes_zh: 采用最终版本的标题及九位作者名单。2026 年更新的 arXiv v3 与 2025 年会议发表时间分开记录；早期预印本的标题、五位作者名单和较小基准规模均不同。

title: IWR-Bench: Can LVLMs reconstruct interactive webpage from a user interaction video?
title_zh: IWR-Bench：大型视觉语言模型能否根据用户交互视频重建可交互网页？
date_basis: Publication year stated by the official ICLR proceedings; no finer publication date is asserted.
date_basis_zh: 采用 ICLR 官方论文集标明的出版年份，不推定更精确的出版日期。
description_en: Tests reconstruction of interactive webpages from user-interaction videos and supplied static assets. Its 113 tasks replay annotated action sequences to assess visual fidelity and functional behavior across observed page states.
description_zh: 测试模型利用用户交互视频和提供的静态资源重建可交互网页的能力。其 113 项任务通过重放标注的操作序列，评估已观察页面状态的视觉保真度与功能行为。
scope_limitations_en: The required output is one HTML file; the paper explicitly instructs models to mock implied backend logic with static JavaScript data. Trajectory coverage and model-based judgments do not prove complete website or backend equivalence.
scope_limitations_zh: 要求输出单个 HTML 文件；论文明确要求用 JavaScript 静态数据模拟隐含的后端逻辑。轨迹覆盖和模型评审均不能证明完整网站或后端等价。
why_fits_en: Provides a direct behavioral reconstruction benchmark beyond static screenshots while making the frontend/backend boundary explicit.
why_fits_zh: 提供超越静态截图的行为重建基准，同时明确前端与后端的能力边界。
metadata_notes: Authors and order follow the published PDF: 20 authors. The proceedings landing page orders some middle authors differently; arXiv v3 and the project page list 21, additionally including Yunfei Zhao. The 2025 preprint date is separate from ICLR 2026 publication.
metadata_notes_zh: 作者及顺序以正式发表的 PDF 为准，共 20 位。论文集网页的部分中间作者顺序不同；arXiv v3 和项目页列出 21 位，另含 Yunfei Zhao。2025 年预印本日期与 ICLR 2026 发表年份分开记录。

title: Dashboard2Code: Evaluating Multimodal Models on Reconstructing Interactive Dashboards
title_zh: Dashboard2Code：评估多模态模型重建交互式仪表盘的能力
date_basis: ACL proceedings publication month.
date_basis_zh: 采用 ACL 会议论文集的出版月份。
description_en: Evaluates agents that actively explore a running dashboard and reconstruct its appearance and interaction logic. DashboardMimic provides 180 Plotly+Dash examples, with code-semantic analysis and dynamic interaction tests for the generated implementations.
description_zh: 评估智能体主动探索运行中的仪表盘后，重建其外观与交互逻辑的能力。DashboardMimic 提供 180 个 Plotly+Dash 示例，并以代码语义分析和动态交互测试评估生成的实现。
scope_limitations_en: Limited to Plotly+Dash dashboards, including model-augmented examples. Some settings expose DOM information and evaluation uses model judges. This is not a general backend-recovery benchmark. The linked dataset requires accepting access conditions and sharing contact information.
scope_limitations_zh: 限定于 Plotly+Dash 仪表盘，包含经模型扩充的示例。部分设置提供 DOM 信息，评估使用模型评审器。它并非通用后端恢复基准。链接的数据集需要接受访问条件并共享联系信息。
why_fits_en: Directly studies reconstruction through active observation, including callbacks and state dependencies rather than screenshot appearance alone.
why_fits_zh: 直接研究通过主动观察进行重建，涵盖回调与状态依赖，而非只比较截图外观。
metadata_notes: The paper links the public code repository directly. Only the public dataset access notice was inspected; gated files were not accessed. Publication metadata follows the final ACL record.
metadata_notes_zh: 论文直接链接至公开代码仓库。数据集仅检查了公开访问说明，未访问受限文件。出版信息以正式 ACL 记录为准。

title: WebUIBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models in WebUI-to-Code
title_zh: WebUIBench：评估多模态大语言模型从网页界面生成代码能力的综合基准
date_basis: ACL proceedings publication month.
date_basis_zh: 采用 ACL 会议论文集的出版月份。
description_en: Diagnoses webpage-to-code capability through visual perception, HTML programming, image-to-HTML understanding, and screenshot reconstruction tasks. It separates underlying skills using question-answer pairs derived from real websites.
description_zh: 通过视觉感知、HTML 编程、图像与 HTML 对应理解，以及截图重建任务，诊断从网页界面生成代码的能力；利用来自真实网站的问答对，分别考察各项基础技能。
scope_limitations_en: Primarily evaluates visual and HTML reconstruction skills. The paper includes a preliminary interaction study, not a full workflow or backend-equivalence benchmark. The official repository currently exposes README and images but not the evaluation scripts described in its instructions.
scope_limitations_zh: 主要评估视觉与 HTML 重建技能。论文虽含初步交互研究，但并非完整流程或后端等价评测。官方仓库目前提供 README 和图片，未提供说明中提及的评估脚本。
why_fits_en: Adds diagnostic evidence for screenshot-based website reconstruction, complementary to end-to-end Design2Code evaluation.
why_fits_zh: 为基于截图的网站重建提供诊断性证据，与 Design2Code 的端到端评估互补。
metadata_notes: The published ACL record supplies the bibliography; repository citation fields remain placeholders and the dataset card displays a different arXiv identifier. The author-linked repository is retained as a project link, not advertised as a runnable code release.
metadata_notes_zh: 书目信息采用正式 ACL 记录；仓库引用字段仍是占位内容，数据集卡片显示的 arXiv 编号也不同。作者链接的仓库作为项目链接保留，不将其宣传为可运行的代码发布。

title: GameReplica: A Benchmark for Black-Box Visual Game Replication by Vision-Language Agents
date_basis: arXiv v1 submission history
title_zh: GameReplica：视觉语言智能体的黑盒视觉游戏复刻基准
date_basis_zh: arXiv v1 的首次提交日期。
description_en: Evaluates whether vision-language agents can infer hidden game rules through screenshots and active interaction, then build runnable single-file HTML replicas across 125 tasks from 25 web games, each with five difficulty levels.
description_zh: 通过来自 25 款网页游戏、各设五个难度级别的 125 个任务，评估视觉语言智能体能否通过截图和主动交互推断隐藏规则，并构建可运行的单文件 HTML 游戏复刻。
scope_limitations_en: The tasks cover rule-driven web puzzles and board games, not native or commercial game reconstruction. Rule, implementation, and visual scores use LLM judges and do not prove behavioral equivalence. The official site provides demos; a benchmark-code repository was not verified.
scope_limitations_zh: 任务覆盖以规则为核心的网页解谜和棋盘游戏，不代表原生或商业游戏重建能力。规则、实现和视觉评分使用 LLM 评审，不能证明行为等价。官方网站提供演示，尚未核实基准代码仓库。
why_fits_en: Directly evaluates active black-box specification recovery and executable game reconstruction, filling the bibliography’s game-replication gap.
why_fits_zh: 直接评估主动黑盒规格恢复与可执行游戏重建，补充书目中的游戏复刻研究。
metadata_notes: The official project page marks the work as under review. arXiv reports the v1 submission on 2026-09-15 and displays its arXiv DOI as pending registration. The project link is a showcase with demos, not a verified release of the full evaluation framework.
metadata_notes_zh: 官方项目页将该工作标注为审稿中。arXiv 记载 v1 于 2026-09-15 提交，并将其 arXiv DOI 标注为待注册。项目链接为含演示的展示页，不代表已核实发布完整评测框架。

title: Reverse Engineering Mobile Application User Interfaces with REMAUI (T)
date_basis: IEEE/Crossref proceedings publication month and author bibliography; conference dates 9–13 November 2015
title_zh: 使用 REMAUI 逆向重建移动应用用户界面
date_basis_zh: IEEE／Crossref 论文集出版月份与作者书目；会议于 2015 年 11 月 9—13 日举行。
description_en: Reconstructs native Android UI code from screenshots or design bitmaps using OCR, computer vision, and layout heuristics; evaluates visual similarity and view hierarchies on 488 screenshots from over 100 Android and iOS applications.
description_zh: 利用 OCR、计算机视觉和布局启发式规则，从截图或设计位图重建原生 Android 界面代码，并使用来自 100 多款 Android 与 iOS 应用的 488 张截图评估视觉相似性和视图层级。
scope_limitations_en: The output is Android UI code; iOS screenshots are inputs, not evidence of native iOS output. Original logic and backend behavior are not recovered, and multi-screen transitions were future work. OCR/layout heuristics can misidentify content. The linked REMAUI v2 repository has older dependencies and is not the exact verified 2015 artifact.
scope_limitations_zh: 输出为 Android 界面代码；iOS 截图属于输入，不代表生成原生 iOS 代码。方法不恢复原始逻辑和后端行为，多屏切换当时仍属后续工作。OCR／布局启发式规则可能误识别内容。所链接的 REMAUI v2 仓库采用较旧依赖，并非已核实的 2015 年原始产物。
why_fits_en: Adds foundational native mobile-interface reconstruction research alongside the existing binary and website papers.
why_fits_zh: 在现有二进制与网站论文之外，补充原生移动界面重建的基础研究。
metadata_notes: IEEE and Crossref include the technical-paper marker “(T)” in the title; the author PDF omits it. The January 2016 IEEE indexing date differs from the November 2015 publication. Pixel to App explicitly identifies the linked repository as REMAUI v2.
metadata_notes_zh: IEEE 和 Crossref 在标题中保留技术论文标记“(T)”，作者 PDF 未包含该标记。IEEE 于 2016 年 1 月收录的日期与 2015 年 11 月的出版日期不同。Pixel to App 明确将所链接仓库标为 REMAUI v2。

title: SPRITE: From Static Mockups to Engine-Ready Game UI
date_basis: Crossref publisher-deposited online publication date
title_zh: SPRITE：从静态设计稿重建可用于游戏引擎的界面
date_basis_zh: Crossref 中由出版方提供的在线出版日期。
description_en: Transforms game-interface screenshots into editable engine assets through hierarchical YAML, visual grounding, asset extraction, and Unity UXML/USS synthesis, with evaluation on a curated game-UI benchmark and review by three senior UI/UX designers.
description_zh: 通过层级化 YAML、视觉定位、素材提取和 Unity UXML／USS 生成，将游戏界面截图转化为可编辑的引擎资源，并在精选游戏界面基准上评估，由三位资深 UI／UX 设计师进行审阅。
scope_limitations_en: The generated interactions cover basic hover, toggle, and click behavior. Complex temporal and drag-and-drop logic remain outside scope, and translucent overlap or ambiguous diegetic layouts can fail. This is game-UI prototyping, not complete gameplay reconstruction; the official page still labels code as coming soon.
scope_limitations_zh: 生成的交互覆盖基本悬停、切换和点击行为，复杂时序与拖放逻辑仍不在范围内；半透明重叠元素或边界不明确的场景内界面可能处理失败。这是游戏界面原型重建，不是完整玩法重建；官方页面仍标注代码即将发布。
why_fits_en: Adds game-specific screenshot-to-engine reconstruction while distinguishing visual and structural recovery from full game behavior.
why_fits_zh: 补充游戏领域从截图到引擎的重建研究，并区分视觉与结构恢复和完整游戏行为。
metadata_notes: Published as a CHI 2026 poster/extended abstract. The publisher title has “SPRITE:From” and “GameUI”; arXiv and the project page normalize these spaces. arXiv/Hugging Face report a March 18 first submission despite the 2604 identifier; the April 13 publication date is independently verified in Crossref. No implementation link is verified.
metadata_notes_zh: 发表于 CHI 2026 海报／扩展摘要集。出版方标题使用“SPRITE:From”和“GameUI”，arXiv 与项目页采用常规空格。虽然编号以 2604 开头，arXiv／Hugging Face 记载首次提交为 3 月 18 日；4 月 13 日出版日期已在 Crossref 独立核实。未核实实现代码链接。

title: RevengeBench: Reverse Engineering Code-Space Policies from Behavioral Experiments
date_basis: arXiv v1 submission history; the non-archival AIWILD workshop acceptance does not create a separate publication date.
title_zh: RevengeBench：通过行为实验逆向恢复代码形式的策略
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv v1 的首次提交日期；AIWILD 非存档研讨会接收不构成另一出版日期。
description_en: Tests whether agents can recover executable decision policies from behavioral traces and self-designed opponent probes, using 75 synthetic policies across five game arenas and measuring held-out action agreement and downstream competitive value.
description_zh: 使用五种游戏环境中的 75 个合成策略，测试智能体能否通过行为轨迹和自行设计的对手探测恢复可执行决策策略，并衡量留出状态上的动作一致性及后续对抗价值。
scope_limitations_en: The targets are fixed synthetic policies, not full games or adaptive adversaries. Agreement on finitely evaluated states does not uniquely identify source code, and some arenas have substantial variance. The public package omits some paper-only plotting and ablation suites; reproduction also needs CodeClash, a container runtime, and model access.
scope_limitations_zh: 目标是固定的合成策略，不是完整游戏或自适应对手。有限评测状态上的动作一致性不能唯一确定源码，部分环境的方差较大。公开包未包含部分仅用于论文的绘图与消融实验；复现还需要 CodeClash、容器运行时和模型访问。
why_fits_en: Provides a game-domain benchmark for agent-assisted behavioral reverse engineering and active experimental design.
why_fits_zh: 为智能体辅助的行为逆向工程与主动实验设计提供游戏领域基准。
metadata_notes: Accepted to the non-archival Second Workshop on Agents in the Wild (AIWILD) at ICML 2026: its OpenReview record was published on 2026-05-23 and is linked from the ICML page for the July 11, 2026 workshop. The workshop call states a non-archival policy, so this entry keeps the arXiv preprint and first-submission date. The repository and an author’s publication page also report the acceptance. The artifact is official, but its documented omitted experiments are not treated as released.
metadata_notes_zh: 已被 ICML 2026 的第二届 Agents in the Wild（AIWILD）非存档研讨会接收：其 OpenReview 记录于 2026-05-23 发布，并由 2026 年 7 月 11 日研讨会的 ICML 页面链接。研讨会征稿说明采用非存档政策，因此本条目保留 arXiv 预印本及首次提交日期。仓库与一位作者的发表列表也记载了该接收信息。产物属于官方项目，但文档明确未包含的实验不视为已发布。

title: pix2code: Generating Code from a Graphical User Interface Screenshot
date_basis: ACM-deposited Crossref proceedings metadata: online and print publication on 19 June 2018; arXiv first submitted 22 May 2017.
title_zh: pix2code：从图形用户界面截图生成代码
date_basis_zh: ACM 向 Crossref 提交的论文集元数据：在线与印刷版均于 2018 年 6 月 19 日出版；arXiv 首次提交于 2017 年 5 月 22 日。
description_en: Learns screenshot-to-DSL generation for native Android XML, iOS Storyboards and web HTML/CSS interfaces, then compiles the DSL into platform UI code.
description_zh: 学习从界面截图生成领域专用语言（DSL），再编译为原生 Android XML、iOS Storyboard 或网页 HTML/CSS 界面代码。
scope_limitations_en: Evaluation uses synthetic screenshot/code pairs: 1,500 training and 250 test instances per platform. Reported accuracy concerns DSL tokens, not complete apps or behavior. Text labels are ignored; platform datasets train separate models using the same architecture. The task covers layout, components and relationships, not application logic or backend recovery. The repository describes an educational research prototype; its older dependencies were not runtime-tested.
scope_limitations_zh: 评测采用合成的截图与代码配对，每个平台含 1,500 个训练实例和 250 个测试实例。报告的准确率针对 DSL 词元，不代表完整应用或行为复现成功率。方法忽略文本标签内容，并以相同架构分别训练各平台模型；范围是布局、组件及其关系，不包括应用逻辑或后端恢复。仓库将其定位为教育用途的研究原型；本条目未对其较旧依赖进行运行测试。
why_fits_en: Adds an early learned screenshot-to-code approach spanning native mobile and web UI reconstruction.
why_fits_zh: 补充一种早期基于学习的截图到代码方法，覆盖原生移动端与网页界面重建。
metadata_notes: The published EICS 2018 proceedings article follows the 2017 arXiv release; this record reviews arXiv v2 dated 19 September 2017. The linked author repository is the implementation identified by that version, reviewed at a current pinned commit rather than claimed to be an unchanged historical release. It contains compiler code and split dataset archives; the actual LICENSE declares Apache 2.0, while the README license badge has a stale filename.
metadata_notes_zh: 2017 年 arXiv 版本之后，论文发表于 EICS 2018 论文集；本条目审阅的是 2017 年 9 月 19 日的 arXiv v2。所链接作者仓库由该版本明确指定，本次核查固定到当前提交，并不声称其仍与历史发布完全相同。仓库包含编译器代码和分卷数据集压缩包；实际 LICENSE 文件声明 Apache 2.0，README 许可证徽章则使用了过时的文件名。

title: Machine Learning-Based Prototyping of Graphical User Interfaces for Mobile Apps
title_zh: 基于机器学习的移动应用图形用户界面原型生成
date_basis: Publisher-deposited print issue date in Crossref (2020-02-01), represented at month precision.
date_basis_zh: 出版方向 Crossref 登记的纸本刊期日期为 2020-02-01，本目录采用月份精度。
description_en: ReDraw turns screenshots or design mock-ups into native Android GUI prototypes by detecting components, classifying widget types with a CNN, and assembling a plausible view hierarchy with a data-driven nearest-neighbor method.
description_zh: ReDraw 通过组件检测、CNN 控件类型分类及数据驱动的近邻层级组装，将截图或设计稿转换为原生 Android 图形界面原型。
scope_limitations_en: The implementation covers 15 Android component classes and one screen at a time; multiple screens require manual combination, and hierarchy construction is tied to the mined screen size. Evaluation concerns appearance and view hierarchy, not recovery of original app logic or backends. Screenshots and reconstructed mock-ups served as proxies for real design artifacts; results were not independently reproduced here.
scope_limitations_zh: 实现覆盖 15 类 Android 组件，每次生成单个屏幕；多屏需要人工组合，层级构建受采集时屏幕尺寸约束。评估关注外观和视图层级，不代表恢复原始应用逻辑或后端。实验以截图和重新制作的设计稿代替真实设计产物；本目录未独立复现实验。
why_fits_en: Adds a data-driven foundation for recovering native widget types and plausible structure from pixels, complementing the existing REMAUI entry.
why_fits_zh: 补充从像素恢复原生控件类型及合理界面结构的数据驱动基础方法，与现有 REMAUI 条目互补。
metadata_notes: IEEE TSE 46(2), pages 196–221, February 2020. The author-hosted accepted manuscript and arXiv v2 are dated 2018; ESEC/FSE 2018 was a journal-first presentation, not the journal publication. Crossref creation on 2018-06-07 is a deposit date, not an independently verified online publication date. The author project page describes a rewritten implementation as forthcoming in Winter 2020; no original code repository was verified. The separately archived ReDraw dataset is dated 2019-01-02 (Zenodo 2530277).
metadata_notes_zh: 发表于 IEEE TSE 第 46 卷第 2 期，196–221 页，刊期为 2020 年 2 月。作者托管的接收稿及 arXiv v2 为 2018 年版本；ESEC/FSE 2018 是期刊优先展示，不是该期刊论文的出版时间。Crossref 的 2018-06-07 创建日期为元数据登记日期，并非已独立核实的在线出版日期。作者项目页仍说明重写实现计划于 2020 年冬季发布；未核实原始代码仓库。单独归档的 ReDraw 数据集日期为 2019-01-02（Zenodo 2530277）。

title: DeclarUI: Bridging Design and Development with Automated Declarative UI Code Generation
date_basis: ACM-deposited Crossref metadata gives 19 June 2025 for online and print publication; the author PDF labels the issue July 2025.
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Software Engineering
title_zh: DeclarUI：以自动生成声明式界面代码连接设计与开发
date_basis_zh: ACM 向 Crossref 提交的元数据将在线及印刷版出版日期列为 2025 年 6 月 19 日；作者 PDF 的期次标签为 2025 年 7 月。
description_en: Combines visual component extraction, multimodal models, page-transition graphs and iterative checks to reconstruct multi-page mobile UI code from designs or screenshots, evaluated with React Native, Flutter and ArkUI.
description_zh: 结合视觉组件提取、多模态模型、页面跳转图与迭代检查，从设计稿或截图重建多页面移动界面代码，并在 React Native、Flutter 和 ArkUI 上评测。
scope_limitations_en: People review and correct the inferred navigation graph. Evaluation covers 50 five-page UI sets; transition coverage and compilation do not establish full business-logic or backend recovery. Framework results vary, and visual metrics imperfectly reflect perceived fidelity. Public scripts and data are available, but no project-level license was found at the reviewed commit.
scope_limitations_zh: 人员需审核并修正推断出的导航图。评测覆盖 50 组各含五页的界面；页面跳转覆盖率与编译成功不代表恢复了完整业务逻辑或后端。各框架结果存在差异，视觉指标也不能完全反映人眼感知的保真度。脚本与数据已公开，但核查的提交中未发现项目级许可证。
why_fits_en: Extends app-interface reconstruction from isolated screens to mobile UI projects with explicit navigation.
why_fits_zh: 将应用界面重建从单个屏幕扩展到具有明确导航关系的移动界面项目。
metadata_notes: This is a PACMSE journal article, volume 2, FSE issue, pages 219–241 (article FSE011), not an unpublished preprint. Its published title adds DeclarUI to the 2024 arXiv title. The author-hosted 23-page article is the main reviewed text; arXiv v1 was also checked. The linked repository is the paper-named artifact, reviewed at a pinned commit without execution.
metadata_notes_zh: 这是 PACMSE 第 2 卷 FSE 专期的期刊论文，页码为 219–241（文章编号 FSE011），并非尚未发表的预印本。正式标题在 2024 年 arXiv 标题前增加了 DeclarUI。主要审阅文本为作者托管的 23 页期刊论文，同时核对了 arXiv v1。所链接仓库由论文明确指定，本次固定提交核查，未执行代码。

title: ProgramBench: Can Language Models Rebuild Programs From Scratch?
title_zh: ProgramBench：语言模型能否从零重建程序？
date_basis: The official NeurIPS 2026 poster listing verifies conference acceptance; no proceedings publication date is asserted.
date_basis_zh: NeurIPS 2026 官方海报列表确认会议接收；不推定论文集的出版日期。
description_en: Evaluates black-box program reconstruction across 200 tasks: agents query an executable and read its documentation, then independently implement a codebase whose behavior is checked by generated tests.
description_zh: 通过 200 项任务评估黑盒程序重建：智能体运行可执行文件进行探测并阅读文档，再独立实现代码库，由生成的测试检查其行为。
scope_limitations_en: Binary inspection, decompilation, and internet access are forbidden during inference. Passing finite tests does not prove complete behavioral equivalence or recovery of the original source. Later live-leaderboard runs are separate from the reviewed arXiv results.
scope_limitations_zh: 推理阶段禁止检查二进制内容、反编译和访问互联网。通过有限测试不能证明完整行为等价或恢复了原始源码。实时榜单中的后续运行结果应与所审阅 arXiv 版本的结果区分。
why_fits_en: Provides an executable benchmark for recovering software behavior through experiments, complementing benchmarks that permit static binary analysis.
why_fits_zh: 为通过实验恢复软件行为提供可执行基准，与允许静态二进制分析的评测互为补充。
metadata_notes: NeurIPS lists a December 2026 poster; this records acceptance, not proceedings publication. The July 2026 DL4C oral was a separate non-archival workshop appearance. The DOI identifies the arXiv preprint. The pinned harness is version 1.2.5 under MIT; its generated-test dataset preserves per-task attribution and upstream license terms, including copyleft obligations for derivative portions.
metadata_notes_zh: NeurIPS 列出 2026 年 12 月的海报报告；本条记录接收状态，不视为论文集已出版。2026 年 7 月的 DL4C 口头报告属于另一次非存档研讨会展示。DOI 指向 arXiv 预印本。固定版本的评测程序为 1.2.5，采用 MIT 许可；生成测试数据集保留逐任务署名与上游许可条款，包括衍生部分的 copyleft 义务。

title: Decompile-Bench: Million-Scale Binary-Source Function Pairs for Real-World Binary Decompilation
title_zh: Decompile-Bench：面向真实二进制反编译的百万级二进制与源码函数对
date_basis: Publication year in the official NeurIPS proceedings and publisher-deposited Crossref metadata; no finer publication date is asserted.
date_basis_zh: 采用 NeurIPS 官方论文集及出版商在 Crossref 登记的出版年份，不推定更精确的出版日期。
description_en: Introduces two million C/C++ binary-source function pairs using a Compile-Trace-Filter pipeline, with an evaluation suite spanning translated HumanEval/MBPP tasks and recent GitHub functions.
description_zh: 通过 Compile-Trace-Filter 流程构建 200 万组 C/C++ 二进制与源码函数对，并提供涵盖转写为 C/C++ 的 HumanEval、MBPP 任务及近期 GitHub 函数的评测集。
scope_limitations_en: This is function-level decompilation. Re-execution tests cover HumanEval/MBPP; GitHub2025 provides no unit tests. Inlining can prevent one-to-one source correspondence, and the fine-tuning study uses 10% of the corpus. These results do not establish whole-program recovery.
scope_limitations_zh: 该工作研究函数级反编译。重新执行测试覆盖 HumanEval、MBPP；GitHub2025 未提供单元测试。内联可能使二进制与源码无法一一对应，微调实验仅使用 10% 的语料。这些结果不能证明整程序恢复能力。
why_fits_en: Adds a training corpus and evaluation artifact for LLM decompilation, distinct from Gao et al.’s existing DecompileBench entry.
why_fits_zh: 补充 LLM 反编译的训练语料与评测产物，不同于现有 Gao 等人的 DecompileBench 条目。
metadata_notes: Author order follows the final PDF, which puts Zuchen Gao before Siyi Wang; the proceedings landing page and Crossref reverse them. arXiv v2 was revised on 2025-10-19. The artifact is the decompile-bench subdirectory of the existing LLM4Decompile repository. Code has an MIT license; the dataset declares CC0-1.0, while model weights have separate terms. These declarations do not replace source-project license review.
metadata_notes_zh: 作者顺序以正式 PDF 为准，其中 Zuchen Gao 位于 Siyi Wang 之前；论文集网页与 Crossref 的顺序相反。arXiv v2 于 2025-10-19 更新。产物位于已有 LLM4Decompile 仓库的 decompile-bench 子目录。代码采用 MIT 许可，数据集声明 CC0-1.0，模型权重另有条款；这些声明不能替代对源项目许可的核查。

title: Fuzzware: Using Precise MMIO Modeling for Effective Firmware Fuzzing
title_zh: Fuzzware：利用精确的 MMIO 建模提升固件模糊测试效果
date_basis: Publication month in the official USENIX proceedings citation; no exact publication day is asserted.
date_basis_zh: 采用 USENIX 官方论文集引用中的出版月份，不推定具体出版日。
description_en: Rehosts monolithic ARM Cortex-M firmware for fuzzing, using locally scoped symbolic execution to model memory-mapped I/O accesses and focus input mutations on values relevant to firmware logic.
description_zh: 重托管单体 ARM Cortex-M 固件以开展模糊测试，利用局部符号执行为内存映射 I/O 访问建模，使输入变异集中于影响固件逻辑的值。
scope_limitations_en: The Cortex-M3/M4 artifact requires memory-map configuration and does not automatically model DMA. Abstracting hardware can produce crashes that are impossible on the physical device. This is an analysis environment, not original-source recovery or faithful full-device reconstruction.
scope_limitations_zh: 面向 Cortex-M3/M4 的产物需要配置内存映射，且不会自动为 DMA 建模。对硬件的抽象可能产生真实设备上不可能出现的崩溃。该工作构建分析环境，不代表恢复原始源码或忠实重建完整设备。
why_fits_en: Shows how firmware logic can be exercised without its original hardware by reconstructing enough of the execution environment for dynamic analysis.
why_fits_zh: 展示如何恢复动态分析所需的执行环境，使固件逻辑能够脱离原始硬件运行。
metadata_notes: The official proceedings give pages 1239–1256 and nine authors. No paper DOI or arXiv identifier was verified. Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.6499215 identifies the software artifact, not this paper. The artifact appendix names the sec22-ae-accepted release and declares Apache-2.0 for code and data; third-party components retain their own terms.
metadata_notes_zh: 官方论文集列出页码 1239–1256 和九位作者。未核实论文 DOI 或 arXiv 标识符。Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.6499215 标识软件产物，并非本论文。产物附录指定 sec22-ae-accepted 版本，并将代码和数据声明为 Apache-2.0；第三方组件仍适用各自条款。

title: FirmAE: Towards Large-Scale Emulation of IoT Firmware for Dynamic Analysis
title_zh: FirmAE：面向动态分析的物联网固件大规模仿真
date_basis: ACM-deposited Crossref print-publication date; the online-publication date is recorded separately in metadata notes.
date_basis_zh: 采用 ACM 在 Crossref 登记的印刷出版日期；在线出版日期在元数据说明中单独记录。
description_en: Extends Firmadyne with empirically derived interventions for boot, networking, NVRAM, kernel behavior, and other runtime failures, enabling Linux router and IP-camera firmware web services to run for dynamic analysis.
description_zh: 在 Firmadyne 基础上，针对启动、网络、NVRAM、内核行为及其他运行失败加入经验性干预，使 Linux 路由器与 IP 摄像机固件的 Web 服务能够运行并接受动态分析。
scope_limitations_en: Arbitration deliberately changes execution and targets functioning web interfaces, not identical physical-device behavior. The evaluation covers ARM little-endian and MIPS little-/big-endian firmware from routers and IP cameras; heuristics may fail on unseen devices or configurations. It reuses firmware binaries rather than recovering their source.
scope_limitations_zh: 仲裁式干预会有意改变执行过程，目标是运行 Web 界面，而非完整复现物理设备行为。评测覆盖路由器与 IP 摄像机的 ARM 小端、MIPS 小端及大端固件；启发式规则可能不适用于未见过的设备或配置。该方法复用固件二进制，并不恢复其源码。
why_fits_en: Provides a concrete firmware-rehosting method and evaluation for restoring analyzable network-service behavior when exact hardware emulation is unavailable.
why_fits_zh: 在无法精确仿真硬件时，为恢复可分析的网络服务行为提供具体的固件重托管方法与评测。
metadata_notes: ACM metadata records print publication on 2020-12-07 and online publication on 2020-12-08, pages 733–745. The six-author paper is separate from later repository updates. The pinned artifact README documents Ubuntu 20.04 and privileged run modes. Its MIT license does not license vendor firmware images or all dependencies; dataset downloads were not tested.
metadata_notes_zh: ACM 元数据记载印刷出版于 2020-12-07，在线出版于 2020-12-08，页码为 733–745。六位作者的论文与仓库后续更新分开记录。固定提交的产物 README 记载了 Ubuntu 20.04 和需要提权的运行模式。仓库的 MIT 许可不涵盖厂商固件镜像或全部依赖；本次未测试数据集下载。

title: NEMESYS: Network Message Syntax Reverse Engineering by Analysis of the Intrinsic Structure of Individual Messages
title_zh: NEMESYS：通过分析单条报文的内在结构逆向推断网络报文语法
date_basis: The official USENIX BibTeX entry identifies August 2018 for the WOOT 18 workshop publication.
date_basis_zh: USENIX 官方 BibTeX 将 WOOT 18 研讨会论文的出版月份列为2018年8月。
description_en: Infers approximate field boundaries within individual binary-protocol messages from changes in bit congruence, and introduces Format Match Score to compare inferred segmentation with known protocol dissectors.
description_zh: 根据单条二进制协议报文内比特一致性的变化，推断近似字段边界，并提出格式匹配分数，将推断的分段结果与已知协议解析器进行比较。
scope_limitations_en: Requires plaintext payloads. Evaluation covers DNS, DHCP and NTP with protocol-tuned parameters. Single-byte fields are not inferred; zero-filled fields, character sequences and pseudo-random values can cause errors. FMS needs known field boundaries for validation. The output is approximate segmentation, not field semantics, a state machine or complete application/device behavior.
scope_limitations_zh: 需要明文载荷。评测覆盖 DNS、DHCP 和 NTP，并针对各协议调节参数。方法无法推断单字节字段；全零字段、字符序列和伪随机值可能导致误差。FMS 验证需要已知字段边界。输出是近似报文分段，不是字段语义、状态机或完整应用／设备行为。
why_fits_en: Provides a foundational method for reconstructing wire-message structure from observed traffic.
why_fits_zh: 为依据观测流量重建通信报文结构提供基础方法。
metadata_notes: The official USENIX citation verifies this workshop paper; no DOI or arXiv identifier was verified. The linked author repository now integrates NEMESYS with later NEMETYL and 2022 methods, so the reviewed current commit is not claimed to be the original 2018 artifact. Its README identifies it as experimental and its LICENSE declares MIT.
metadata_notes_zh: USENIX 官方引文确认了这篇研讨会论文；尚未核实 DOI 或 arXiv 标识。所链接的作者仓库如今整合了 NEMESYS、后续 NEMETYL 及2022年方法，因此本次核查的当前提交不被视为2018年原始产物。README 将其定位为实验性软件，LICENSE 声明 MIT。

title: NetPlier: Probabilistic Network Protocol Reverse Engineering from Message Traces
title_zh: NetPlier：基于报文记录的概率网络协议逆向工程
date_basis: Publisher-deposited Crossref metadata supplies publication year 2021; the publisher PDF separately identifies the 21–25 February 2021 symposium.
date_basis_zh: 出版方向 Crossref 提交的元数据仅给出出版年份2021；出版方 PDF 另列研讨会日期为2021年2月21—25日。
description_en: Uses multiple sequence alignment and probabilistic keyword-field inference to cluster network messages by type, evaluated across ten protocols with downstream format and state-machine analysis.
description_zh: 通过多序列比对与概率式关键字段推断，按类型对网络报文聚类，并在十种协议上评测及开展后续格式与状态机分析。
scope_limitations_en: Requires unencrypted traces and cannot recover unseen message types. Larger alignments, sub-byte keywords and one-way traffic can reduce accuracy. Format/FSM inference is downstream evaluation rather than the main contribution; state semantics in a case study were manually annotated. These models do not establish complete application/device reconstruction.
scope_limitations_zh: 需要未加密的报文记录，无法恢复从未出现的报文类型。较大的比对、亚字节关键字段及单向流量可能降低准确性。格式／有限状态机推断属于下游评测而非主要贡献；一个案例中的状态语义由人工标注。这些模型不能证明已完整重建应用／设备。
why_fits_en: Connects observed application/device traffic to message-type models needed for protocol reconstruction.
why_fits_zh: 将观测到的应用／设备流量转化为协议重建所需的报文类型模型。
metadata_notes: The publisher paper cites netplier-tool/NetPlier, which now redirects to yapengye/NetPlier. The pinned GPLv3 artifact implements keyword inference and clustering evaluation; its core retains TODOs for iteration and format inference. Do not treat this public repository as a complete reproduction of all paper stages. No runtime reproduction was performed.
metadata_notes_zh: 出版方论文引用 netplier-tool/NetPlier，当前重定向至 yapengye/NetPlier。固定提交下的 GPLv3 产物实现了关键字段推断与聚类评测；核心代码仍将迭代和格式推断列为 TODO。不能将此公开仓库视为论文所有阶段的完整复现。本次未进行运行复现。

title: ProgramDistill: From Interactive Web Apps to Verifiable Reference-Guided SWE Tasks
title_zh: ProgramDistill：将交互式 Web 应用转化为可验证的参考驱动软件工程任务
date_basis: arXiv v1 submission history; the earlier author blog date is separate.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv v1 的首次提交日期；作者博客的较早发布日期另行区分。
description_en: Evaluates recovery of web-app behavior from a live reference with hidden source. It provides 4,063 feature-restoration tasks across 26 applications and a separate 12-application reconstruction setting, scored by replaying dependent browser workflows.
description_zh: 评测智能体从源码不可见的运行参考中恢复 Web 应用行为的能力，提供覆盖 26 个应用的 4,063 项功能恢复任务，以及独立的 12 应用重建设置，通过重放具有依赖关系的浏览器工作流评分。
scope_limitations_en: Tests cover finite, model-mined behaviors in self-contained apps, including SaaS clones. Persistence failures can be detected through replayed workflows, but passing does not establish all backend or database invariants. Evaluated agents receive structured browser observations without screenshots; visual fidelity is not measured. Public verifiers and reference solutions are not a contamination-resistant test set.
scope_limitations_zh: 测试限于自包含应用（包括 SaaS 克隆）中由模型挖掘的有限行为。重放工作流可发现持久化失败，但通过测试不能证明全部后端或数据库不变量成立。被评测智能体接收不含截图的结构化浏览器观察，未衡量视觉保真度。公开验证器与参考解答也不构成抗污染测试集。
why_fits_en: Directly studies reference-guided behavioral reconstruction beyond screenshot-to-HTML, including dependent state changes and fresh verification of submitted implementations.
why_fits_zh: 直接研究超越截图到 HTML 的参考驱动行为重建，涵盖有依赖关系的状态变化，并在全新验证环境中检查提交的实现。
metadata_notes: The DOI resolves and DataCite records registration on 2026-09-17, despite arXiv’s stale pending banner. Separately, the paper was accepted to the non-archival Workshop on Interpreting Agent Behavior (IAB) at NeurIPS 2026, scheduled for December 12, 2026; its OpenReview record was published on 2026-10-04. That record and the workshop listing put Xingdi Yuan before Alessandro Sordoni; the authors here follow arXiv v1. The public release contains executable benchmark packages, not the mining, task-generation or orchestration pipeline. ProgramDistill-authored artifacts declare MIT; included applications and assets retain upstream terms. The paper and later packaged release are distinguished; no experiments were reproduced.
metadata_notes_zh: DOI 已可解析，DataCite 记载其于 2026-09-17 注册，尽管 arXiv 仍显示过时的待注册提示。此外，该论文已被 NeurIPS 2026 的 Interpreting Agent Behavior（IAB）非存档研讨会接收，研讨会定于 2026 年 12 月 12 日举行；其 OpenReview 记录于 2026-10-04 发布。该记录与研讨会论文列表将 Xingdi Yuan 排在 Alessandro Sordoni 之前，本条目作者顺序以 arXiv v1 为准。公开版本包含可执行基准任务包，但不包含行为挖掘、任务生成或编排流水线。ProgramDistill 自有产物声明 MIT 许可，所含应用与资源仍适用上游条款。论文与后续任务包发布分开记录，本次未复现实验。

title: Vision2Web: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Visual Website Development with Agent Verification
title_zh: Vision2Web：采用智能体验证的分层视觉网站开发基准
date_basis: Publication date stated for PMLR volume 306; the July 6–11 conference dates are not used as the publication date.
date_basis_zh: 采用 PMLR 第 306 卷标明的出版日期；不将 7 月 6—11 日的会议日期作为出版日期。
description_en: Benchmarks website development from visual prototypes and written requirements across 100 static-page, 66 interactive-frontend and 27 full-stack tasks, combining workflow-based functional checks with model-judged visual comparison.
description_zh: 基于视觉原型和文字需求评测网站开发，包含 100 项静态页面、66 项交互前端与 27 项全栈任务，将基于工作流的功能检查与模型进行的视觉比较结合。
scope_limitations_en: The full-stack tier is specification-driven, not reconstruction solely by exploring a live website. Workflows test state management and CRUD outcomes, but finite agent judgments do not establish exact backend or durable-database equivalence. The current public evaluator maintains a browser session within each workflow and permits local business-API checks; this is not a universal persistence proof.
scope_limitations_zh: 全栈层级由明确规格驱动，并非仅通过探索运行中的网站进行重建。工作流测试状态管理与增删改查结果，但有限的智能体判断不能证明后端或数据库持久性的精确等价。当前公开评测器在每个工作流内保持浏览器会话，并允许检查本地业务 API；这不构成通用的持久化证明。
why_fits_en: A useful comparison for evaluating interactive and stateful website reconstruction, while separating written-specification development from behavior-only inference.
why_fits_zh: 可用于比较交互式、有状态网站重建的评测方法，同时明确区分根据文字规格开发与仅凭行为推断。
metadata_notes: The final PMLR paper has seven authors and pages 41393–41415; arXiv v3 is dated 2026-07-20. Current artifact evaluation differs from the paper configuration. Licensing signals conflict: README text says CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0, Hugging Face metadata says Apache-2.0, the project page says CC BY-SA 4.0, and setup.py lists MIT while the repository has no LICENSE file. No uniform artifact license is asserted.
metadata_notes_zh: 正式 PMLR 论文包含七位作者，页码为 41393–41415；arXiv v3 日期为 2026-07-20。当前产物的评测配置与论文不同。许可信息存在冲突：README 正文声明 CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0，Hugging Face 元数据标为 Apache-2.0，项目页声明 CC BY-SA 4.0，setup.py 列出 MIT，但仓库没有 LICENSE 文件。因此不宣称产物适用统一许可。

title: From UI Design Image to GUI Skeleton: A Neural Machine Translator to Bootstrap Mobile GUI Implementation
title_zh: 从 UI 设计图到 GUI 骨架：辅助启动移动界面实现的神经机器翻译器
date_basis: Publisher-deposited Crossref publication date for the ICSE proceedings article.
date_basis_zh: 出版方提交至 Crossref 的 ICSE 会议论文集文章出版日期。
description_en: UI2code translates a mobile UI image into an Android component hierarchy and layout skeleton using a neural encoder-decoder. The paper evaluates structural prediction and a small developer study of implementing layouts from generated skeletons.
description_zh: UI2code 使用神经编码器—解码器，将移动 UI 图像转换为 Android 组件层级与布局骨架。论文评估了结构预测，并通过小规模开发者实验研究如何基于生成的骨架实现布局。
scope_limitations_en: The output covers component types and hierarchy from a single image; detailed styling and text require developer work. Structural token accuracy and an eight-participant study on five screenshots do not establish complete visual fidelity, navigation, app logic or backend recovery. The main split is screenshot-based; a separate evaluation on 1,208 images from 20 unseen apps provides limited generalization evidence.
scope_limitations_zh: 输出仅覆盖单张图像中的组件类型与层级；详细样式和文本仍需开发者补充。结构标记准确率以及针对五张截图、由八名参与者开展的实验，不能证明完整视觉保真度，也不代表恢复了导航、应用逻辑或后端。主数据集按截图划分；独立评估使用了 20 个未见应用的 1,208 张图像，提供了有限的泛化证据。
why_fits_en: A native-app reconstruction foundation that explicitly generates and evaluates GUI structure from visual observations, beyond locating interface elements.
why_fits_zh: 这是原生应用重建的基础工作，明确从视觉观察生成并评估 GUI 结构，研究范围超出了界面元素定位。
metadata_notes: The author-hosted PDF prints 10.1145/3180155.3180222, which identifies another paper; the DOI here follows publisher-deposited metadata for this title, pages 665–676. The artifact README lists 29,887 screenshots, while the paper reports 185,277 image/skeleton pairs; they should not be treated as the same released corpus. The pinned legacy Torch/Lua repository has no license file; external data and model downloads were not tested.
metadata_notes_zh: 作者托管 PDF 印有 10.1145/3180155.3180222，但该 DOI 对应另一篇论文；此处采用出版方为本标题提交的 DOI，页码为 665–676。代码仓库 README 列出 29,887 张截图，论文则报告 185,277 对图像与骨架，不应视为同一套已发布语料。固定版本的旧版 Torch/Lua 仓库没有许可证文件；未测试外部数据和模型下载。

title: Tycho: Active Abstraction with Programmatic World Models for ARC-AGI-3
title_zh: Tycho：面向 ARC-AGI-3 的程序化世界模型主动抽象
date_basis: First public arXiv submission date; version v1 was reviewed.
date_basis_zh: 首次公开提交至 arXiv 的日期；核查版本为 v1。
description_en: Tycho constructs editable Python models of game state, transitions, rendering and outcomes from action/observation histories in unfamiliar ARC-AGI-3 games. It checks model predictions against recorded transitions and can use, repair or bypass these models during planning.
description_zh: Tycho 根据陌生 ARC-AGI-3 游戏中的动作与观察历史，构建可编辑的 Python 模型，描述游戏状态、状态转移、渲染与结果。它将模型预测与已记录的转移进行核对，并在规划时选择使用、修复或绕过这些模型。
scope_limitations_en: Evaluation uses one stochastic run per configuration on 25 public games and 183 levels; five games informed harness development. Models may abstain on cells or accept bounded rendering variants. Transition replay and game scores do not establish complete engine reconstruction, correct objectives, unseen-state fidelity, unseen-game generalization or run-to-run reliability; the agent can bypass modeling.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估针对 25 个公开游戏、183 个关卡，每种配置仅进行一次随机运行；其中五个游戏曾用于开发智能体框架。模型可以不预测部分像素格，或接受有限的渲染变体。转移回放和游戏分数不能证明完整引擎重建、目标识别正确、未见状态保真度、未见游戏泛化或多次运行的可靠性；智能体也可以绕过建模。
why_fits_en: Studies executable reconstruction of observed game dynamics and checks model fidelity separately from task success, providing a bounded behavioral reconstruction case.
why_fits_zh: 研究对已观察游戏动态的可执行重建，并将模型保真度与任务成功分开检验，提供了范围明确的行为重建案例。
metadata_notes: The arXiv posting date is July 30; the manuscript header and software release use July 29. DataCite confirms the arXiv DOI is registered and findable. The pinned author artifact is Apache-2.0 and includes source, prompts, paper configurations and compact evaluation evidence; ARC environment terms are separate. Python >=3.12, model/ARC access and a Docker or Finch sandbox are documented requirements; no installation or experiments were run.
metadata_notes_zh: arXiv 发布日期为 7 月 30 日；文稿页首和软件发布采用 7 月 29 日。DataCite 确认 arXiv DOI 已注册且处于可检索状态。固定版本的作者产物采用 Apache-2.0，包含源码、提示词、论文配置和精简评估证据；ARC 环境适用独立条款。文档要求 Python >=3.12、模型与 ARC 访问权限，以及 Docker 或 Finch 沙箱；未进行安装或实验复现。
